identity: The main character is the man in the reference photos. Preserve his exact facial identity: face shape, eyes, nose, smile, curly dark hair with short faded sides, salt-and-pepper goatee, olive skin, heavy gold Cuban link chain.
look: Cinematic photoreal music video film still, wide 16:9, 35mm anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture.
